description.p: A Spotify client written entirely in C, with no Rust and no Electron. It speaks Spotify's own protocol directly and decodes and plays audio itself, rather than driving another running client.
Includes a 15-band graphic equaliser with a draggable response curve and an optional resampler.

Requires a Spotify Premium account. Playback is licensed per account at the protocol level, and a free account is refused an audio key for every format a track offers, so it cannot play regardless of client.
